text:
alex: kicking off a CONFIG-ONLY change for soft limits + timeouts (tiny window). deploying as a slimshift timebox, no model changes. deploybot: queued change v2.3.1-config-slimshift for route /generate

alex: plan: 10% canary for 15m -> 50% for 15m -> full. softlimit = 0.85 of normal quota, request timeout reduced from 8s -> 6s, batching max_tokens=64, max_batch_size=12
maria: pinging infra for headcount in case we need a fast rollback. also posting a quick sanity checklist below

maria: checklist: 
- canary metrics stream on (p99 latency, error-rate, queue-depth)
- deploybot health hooks enabled
- rollback playbook pinned to channel

kai: adding rollback thresholds: p95 latency +15% over baseline OR error-rate spike >0.8% over 5m OR kvcache miss rate +10% -> immediate unpin/rollback. ops: ack?

ops: ack from SRE on-call. will watch saturations. set alert: when p95 > 450ms for 3m or 5xx rate > 0.5% we page ops.

alex: dropping config snippet here for reference to apply via deploybot (config-only):
```json
{
  "route": "/generate",
  "change_window": "2026-03-21T22:00:00Z/2026-03-21T22:30:00Z",
  "canary": {"pct": 10, "duration_min": 15},
  "soft_limits": {"tenant_qps_factor": 0.85},
  "timeouts_ms": {"request_timeout": 6000, "idle_timeout": 2000},
  "batching": {"max_tokens": 64, "max_batch_size": 12}
}
```

deploybot: apply request received by infra-ci. starting canary deployment to 10% (fleet slice a).

maria: I'll run prompt-stability check (existing eval suite) against canary after 5 min. will report anomalies here.

kai: small note: if we see increased cold-starts on dedicated nodes, prefer extending canary rather than immediate full rollback; tie to the p95 threshold and 5xx rate.

ops: ops-runbook link: https://internal.ops/runbooks/slimshift. quick rollback command (if needed):
```bash
deploybot rollback --request 1768123456 --reason "safety-trigger"
```

alex: if everything looks good at 10% -> bump to 50% at +15m. final full rollout only if p95 within +5% and 5xx within baseline.

maria: canary metrics: p95=380ms, error-rate=0.12% (baseline p95=360ms, baseline error-rate=0.10%). no alerts. moving to +50% at next step.

deploybot: promoted canary to 50% (fleet slice b). monitoring hooks active.

kai: monitoring: queuing elevated slightly but within expected range. watch kvcache miss closely (we saw a small blip earlier).

maria: prompt-stability results: diffs under threshold (<=1%). rolling forward to full in 10m if no changes.

ops: setting temporary soft-cap on noisy tenants during final ramp to avoid noisy-neighbor spikes. will remove after 30m.

deploybot: full rollout complete. change state: applied v2.3.1-config-slimshift -> active.

alex: release note snippet: "Config-only rollout: soft tenant QPS factor 0.85, request timeout 6s, batching tuned (max_tokens=64, max_batch_size=12). Canary passed internal stability checks; observe p95 and 5xx alerts for next 1h."

maria: thank you everyone. will leave monitoring pinned for 60m and then close thread if stable. :thumbsup:

ops: closing watch after 60m unless page.

(END)
